paragraphs: Adobe Inc. (  ə-DOH-bee), formerly Adobe Systems Incorporated, is an American multinational computer software company based in San Jose, California. It offers a wide range of programs from web design tools, photo manipulation, and vector creation to video and audio editing, mobile app development, print layout and animation software.

It has historically specialized in software for the creation and publication of a wide range of content, including Graphics, Photography, Illustration, Animation, multimedia/video, Motion pictures and print. Its flagship products include Adobe Photoshop image editing software; Adobe Illustrator vector-based illustration software; Adobe Acrobat and the Portable Document Format (PDF); and a host of tools primarily for audio-visual content creation, editing, and publishing. Adobe offered a bundled solution of its products named Adobe Creative Suite, which evolved into a subscription-based offering named Adobe Creative Cloud. The company also expanded into digital marketing software and in 2021 was considered one of the top global leaders in Customer Experience Management (CXM).

Adobe was founded in December 1982 by John Warnock and Charles Geschke, who established the company after leaving Xerox PARC to develop and sell the PostScript page description language. In 1985, Apple Computer licensed PostScript for use in its LaserWriter printers, which helped spark the desktop publishing revolution. Adobe later developed animation and multimedia through its acquisition of Macromedia, from which it acquired Macromedia Flash; video editing and compositing software with Adobe Premiere, later known as Adobe Premiere Pro; low-code web development with Adobe Muse; and a suite of software for digital marketing management.

As of 2022, Adobe had more than 26,000 employees worldwide. Adobe also has major development operations in the United States in Newton, New York City, Arden Hills, Lehi, Seattle, Austin and San Francisco. It also has major development operations in Noida and Bangalore in India. The company has long been the dominant tech firm in design and creative software, despite attracting criticism for its policies and practices, particularly around Adobe Creative Cloud's switch to subscription-only pricing and its early termination fees for its most promoted Creative Cloud plan, the latter of which attracted a joint civil lawsuit from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and the U.S. Department of Justice in 2024.

images.caption: Adobe Founders Tower, San Jose, CA, south side

people.name: Shantanu Narayen
people.title: Chair of the Board of Directors and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Joined Adobe in January 1998 and held successive leadership roles before becoming Chief Executive Officer and joining the Board in December 2007. He was named Chair of the Board in January 2017 and also serves on Pfizer's board of directors.
people.quote: Mr. Narayen currently serves as our Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the Board.

people.name: Daniel Durn
people.title: Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President, Finance, Technology, Security and Operations
people.bio: Joined Adobe in October 2021 as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. Previously served as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Applied Materials from August 2017 to October 2021.
people.quote: Mr. Durn currently serves as our Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President, Finance, Technology, Security and Operations.

people.name: Anil Chakravarthy
people.title: President, Customer Experience Orchestration Business
people.bio: Joined Adobe in January 2020 and served as President, Digital Experience Business from December 2021 to January 2026. Previously served as Chief Executive Officer of Informatica from August 2015 to January 2020.
people.quote: Mr. Chakravarthy currently serves as our President, Customer Experience Orchestration Business.

people.name: David Wadhwani
people.title: President, Creativity and Productivity Business
people.bio: Initially joined Adobe in 2005 through its acquisition of Macromedia and rejoined in June 2021 after serving as President and CEO of AppDynamics and as a Venture Partner at Greylock Partners. Served as Adobe's President, Digital Media Business from December 2021 to January 2026.
people.quote: Mr. Wadhwani currently serves as our President, Creativity and Productivity Business.

people.name: Lara Balazs
people.title: Chief Marketing Officer and Executive Vice President, Global Marketing
people.bio: Joined Adobe in December 2024. Previously served as Executive Vice President, General Manager, Strategic Partnership Group and Chief Marketing Officer of Intuit from February 2021 to September 2024.
people.quote: Ms. Balazs joined Adobe in December 2024 and currently serves as our Chief Marketing Officer and Executive Vice President, Global Marketing.

people.name: Louise Pentland
people.title: Chief Legal Officer and Executive Vice President, Legal and Government Relations
people.bio: Louise Pentland serves as Adobe's Chief Legal Officer and Executive Vice President, Legal and Government Relations. She joined Adobe in May 2025.
people.quote: Ms. Pentland joined Adobe in May 2025 and was not an NEO in fiscal years 2024 and 2023.

people.name: Cristiano Amon
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Qualcomm Incorporated and a member of its board since June 2021. Joined Qualcomm in 1995 as an engineer.
people.quote: Mr. Amon, 55, has served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Qualcomm Incorporated

people.name: Amy Banse
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as a partner at Mosaic General Partnership since March 2021. Previously served as Executive Vice President of Comcast and Managing Director and Head of Funds of Comcast Ventures.
people.quote: Ms. Banse, 66, has served as a partner at Mosaic General Partnership (formerly Mastry, Inc.)

people.name: Melanie Boulden
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as a consultant for Tyson Foods since June 2025, after serving as its Executive Vice President and Chief Growth Officer from February 2023 to May 2025. Previously held senior leadership roles at Coca-Cola.
people.quote: Ms. Boulden, 53, has served as a consultant for Tyson Foods, Inc.

people.name: Frank Calderoni
people.title: Lead Director
people.bio: Served as Chief Executive Officer of Velocity Global from April 2023 to August 2024. Previously served as Chair and Chief Executive Officer of Anaplan and held senior financial leadership roles at Red Hat and Cisco.
people.quote: Mr. Calderoni, 68, served as the Chief Executive Officer of Velocity Global

people.name: Laura Desmond
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as Chief Executive Officer of Smartly.io since September 2022 and Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Eagle Vista Partners since March 2017. Previously served as Chief Revenue Officer of Publicis Groupe and Global Chief Executive Officer of Starcom MediaVest Group.
people.quote: Ms. Desmond, 60, has served as Chief Executive Officer at Smartly.io

people.name: Shantanu Narayen
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Joined Adobe in January 1998 and became Chief Executive Officer and a director in December 2007. Was named Chair of the Board in January 2017.
people.quote: Mr. Narayen, 62, currently serves as our Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the Board.

people.name: Spencer Neumann
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as Chief Financial Officer of Netflix since January 2019. Previously served as Chief Financial Officer of Activision Blizzard and held senior positions at The Walt Disney Company.
people.quote: Mr. Neumann, 56, has served as Chief Financial Officer of Netflix, Inc.

people.name: Kathleen Oberg
people.title: Director
people.bio: Serves as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President, Development of Marriott International, with retirement effective March 31, 2026. Began her Marriott career in 1999 and has held several senior financial leadership roles.
people.quote: Ms. Oberg, 65, currently serves as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President, Development of Marriott International, Inc.

people.name: Dheeraj Pandey
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as Chair and Chief Executive Officer of DevRev since December 2020. Co-founded Nutanix in 2009 and served as its Chief Executive Officer and board Chair.
people.quote: Mr. Pandey, 50, has served as the Chair and Chief Executive Officer of DevRev, Inc.

people.name: David Ricks
people.title: Director
people.bio: Serves as Chair, President and Chief Executive Officer of Eli Lilly and Company.
people.quote:
David Ricks

people.name: Daniel Rosensweig
people.title: Director
people.bio: Serves as President, Chief Executive Officer and Co-Chair of Chegg.
